quotes.quote: I even love the smell of books.
quotes.author: Adriana Trigiani

quotes.quote: We're all strangers connected by what we reveal, what we share, what we take away--our stories. I guess that's what I love about books--they are thin strands of humanity that tether us to one another for a small bit of time, that make us feel less alone or even more comfortable with our aloneness, if need be.
quotes.author: Libba Bray

quotes.quote: Reading is like thinking, like praying, like talking to a friend, like expressing your ideas, like listening to other people's ideas, like listening to music, like looking at the view, like taking a walk on the beach.
quotes.author: Roberto BolaÃ±o,  2666

quotes.quote: In the shop we buy and sell them, but in truth books have no owner. Every book you see here has been somebody's best friend.
quotes.author: Carlos Ruiz ZafÃ³n,  The Shadow of the Wind

quotes.quote: The person who deserves most pity is a lonesome one on a rainy day who doesn't know how to read.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.quote: Why does one begin to write? Because she feels misunderstood, I guess. Because it never comes out clearly enough when she tries to speak. Because she wants to rephrase the world, to take it in and give it back again differently, so that everything is used and nothing is lost. Because it's something to do to pass the time until she is old enough to experience the things she writes about.
quotes.author: Nicole Krauss

quotes.quote: I'm a book lover. I've probably already fucked a whole library.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  My love can only occupy one person at a time

quotes.quote: Of all things, I liked books best.
quotes.author: Nikola Tesla

quotes.quote: A book is more than a verbal structure or series of verbal structures; it is the dialogue it establishes with its reader and the intonation it imposes upon his voice and the changing and durable images it leaves in his memory. A book is not an isolated being: it is a relationship, an axis of innumerable relationships.
quotes.author: Jorge Luis Borges

quotes.quote: There comes a time in your life when you have to choose to turn the page, write another book or simply close it.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: [I]t's not just the books under fire now that worry me. It is the books that will never be written. The books that will never be read. And all due to the fear of censorship. As always, young readers will be the real losers.
quotes.author: Judy Blume

quotes.quote: Read a thousand books, and your words will flow like a river.
quotes.author: Lisa See,  Snow Flower and the Secret Fan

quotes.quote: Never lend books, for no one ever returns them; the only books I have in my library are books that other folks have lent me.
quotes.author: Anatole France

quotes.quote: Always read stuff that will make you look good if you die in the middle of it.
quotes.author: P.J. O'Rourke

quotes.quote: Reading is that fruitful miracle of a communication in the midst of solitude.
quotes.author: Marcel Proust

quotes.quote: When I open them, most of the books have the smell of an earlier time leaking out between the pages - a special odor of the knowledge and emotions that for ages have been calmly resting between the covers. Breathing it in, I glance through a few pages before returning each book to its shelf.
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  Kafka on the Shore

quotes.quote: We owe it to each other to tell stories.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman

quotes.quote: Reading changes your life. Reading unlocks worlds unknown or forgotten, taking travelers around the world and through time. Reading helps you escape the confines of school and pursue your own education. Through characters - the saints and the sinners, real or imagined - reading shows you how to be a better human being.
quotes.author: Donalyn Miller,  The Book Whisperer: Awakening the Inner Reader in Every Child

quotes.quote: As a fiction writer, let me make it up, and let me make it up to you. I'll pen our love story, if you'll be my co-author.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: All thoughts, secret or spoken, belong in a coffee table book written in Braille, so you can really feel the emotions.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Neither novels or their readers benefit from any attempts to divine whether any facts hide inside a story. Such efforts attack the very idea that made-up stories can matter, which is sort of the foundational assumption of our species.
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: Wisdom.... comes not from age, but from education and learning.
quotes.author: Anton Chekhov

quotes.quote: There are few sights sadder than a ruined book.
quotes.author: Lemony Snicket,  The Wide Window

quotes.quote: I lay on the bed and lost myself in stories. I liked that. Books were safer than other people anyway.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman,  The Ocean at the End of the Lane

quotes.quote: In a bookstore you can find me in the romance section, because I'm not a lover, I'm a reader.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  Love quotes for the ages. Specifically ages 18-81.

quotes.quote: A good story is always more dazzling than a broken piece of truth.
quotes.author: Diane Setterfield,  The Thirteenth Tale

quotes.quote: It's a rare book that wins the battle against drooping eyelids.
quotes.author: Tracy Chevalier

quotes.quote: All I have learned, I learned from books.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: Governments and fashions come and go but Jane Eyre is for all time.
quotes.author: Jasper Fforde,  The Eyre Affair

quotes.quote: Reading well is one of the great pleasures that solitude can afford you.
quotes.author: Harold Bloom

quotes.quote: Literature is my Utopia
quotes.author: Helen Keller

quotes.quote: When writers die they become books, which is, after all, not too bad an incarnation."[As attributed by Alastair Reid in Neruda and Borges, The New Yorker, June 24, 1996; as well as in The Talk of the Town, The New Yorker, July 7, 1986]
quotes.author: Jorge Luis Borges

quotes.quote: What refuge is there for the victim who is oppressed with the feeling that there are a thousand new books he ought to read, while life is only long enough for him to attempt to read a hundred?
quotes.author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.,  Over the Teacups

quotes.quote: Writers are the exorcists of their own demons.
quotes.author: Mario Vargas Llosa

quotes.quote: Don't mark up the Library's copy, you fool! Librarians are Unprankable. They'll track you down! They have skills!
quotes.author: Charles Ogden

quotes.quote: I'll bet opening a store called Boobs and Books would increase literacy. I prefer a hands-on approach to learning.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: You want to remember that while you're judging the book, the book is also judging you.
quotes.author: Stephen King,  Night Shift

quotes.quote: Personally, I am a hedonistic reader; I have never read a book merely because it was ancient. I read books for the aesthetic emotions they offer me, and I ignore the commentaries and criticism.
quotes.author: Jorge Luis Borges,  Seven Nights

quotes.quote: His hands were weak and shaking from carrying far too many books from the bookshop. It was the best feeling.
quotes.author: Joseph Gordon-Levitt,  The Tiny Book of Tiny Stories, Vol. 1

quotes.quote: I read the fuck out of every book I can get my hands on.
quotes.author: Nick Hornby,  A Long Way Down

quotes.quote: If you surround yourself with the good and righteous, they can only raise you up. If you surround yourself with the others, they will drag you down into the doldrums of mediocrity, and they will keep you there, but only as long as you permit it.
quotes.author: Mark Glamack

quotes.quote: I have an idea that the only thing which makes it possible to regard this world we live in without disgust is the beauty which now and then men create out of the chaos. The pictures they paint, the music they compose, the books they write, and the lives they lead. Of all these the richest in beauty is the beautiful life. That is the perfect work of art.
quotes.author: W. Somerset Maugham,  The Painted Veil

quotes.quote: She should have done science, not spent all her time with her head in novels. Novels gave you a completely false idea about life, they told lies and they implied there were endings when in reality there were no endings, everything just went on and on and on.
quotes.author: Kate Atkinson,  Case Histories

quotes.quote: There is no scent so pleasant to my nostrils as that faint, subtle reek which comes from an ancient book.
quotes.author: Arthur Conan Doyle

quotes.quote: Without libraries what have we? We have no past and no future.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury

quotes.quote: After that, the book will fade, the way all books fade in your mind. But I hope you will remember this:A man walking fast down a dark lonely street. Quick steps and hard breathing, all wonder and need. A bell above a door and the tinkle it makes. A clerk and a ladder and warm golden light, and then: the right book exactly, at exactly the right time.
quotes.author: Robin Sloan,  Mr. Penumbra's 24-Hour Bookstore

quotes.quote: Never Let anyone tell you that you can't; show them that you can.
quotes.author: Gloria Mallette

quotes.quote: Books may look like nothing more than words on a page, but they are actually an infinitely complex imaginotransference technology that translates odd, inky squiggles into pictures inside your head.
quotes.author: Jasper Fforde,  The Well of Lost Plots

quotes.quote: I was raised among books, making invisible friends in pages that seemed cast from dust and whose smell I carry on my hands to this day.
quotes.author: Carlos Ruiz ZafÃ³n,  The Shadow of the Wind

quotes.quote: Books can be dangerous. The best ones should be labeled "This could change your life.
quotes.author: Helen Exley

quotes.quote: The Book of Life, I'm still writing it--both literally and literarily. So far I've written the Table of Contents. Right now it's more of a coffee table.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Only my books anoint me, and a few friends, those who reach into my veins.
quotes.author: Anne Sexton,  The Complete Poems

quotes.quote: Children deprived of words become school dropouts; dropouts deprived of hope behave delinquently. Amateur censors blame delinquency on reading immoral books and magazines, when in fact, the inability to read anything is the basic trouble.
quotes.author: Peter S. Jennison

quotes.quote: There is a great deal of difference between an eager man who wants to read a book and a tired man who wants a book to read.
quotes.author: G.K. Chesterton

quotes.quote: Knocking on a door is so violent. Instead, try talking to the door to get it to open up to you. I should write a self-help book for door-to-door salesmen.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: I'm trying to translate what my cat says and put it in a book, but how many homonyms are there for meow?
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  The Days of Yay are Here! Wake Me Up When They're Over.

quotes.quote: When a reader falls in love with a book, it leaves its essence inside him, like radioactive fallout in an arable field, and after that there are certain crops that will no longer grow in him, while other, stranger, more fantastic growths may occasionally be produced."[Books vs. Goons, L.A. Times, April 24, 2005]
quotes.author: Salman Rushdie

quotes.quote: There's a hunger for stories in all of us, adults too. We need stories so much that we're even willing to read bad books to get them, if the good books won't supply them.
quotes.author: Philip Pullman

quotes.quote: I attempted briefly to consecrate myself in the public library, believing every crack in my soul could be chinked with a book.
quotes.author: Barbara Kingsolver,  The Poisonwood Bible

quotes.quote: The ability to read awoke inside of me some long dormant craving to be mentally alive.
quotes.author: Malcolm X,  The Autobiography of Malcolm X

quotes.quote: Wear the old coat and buy the new book.
quotes.author: Austin Phelps

quotes.quote: I wrote an edible cookbook. The pages are made out of tortillas. It's also the Book of Love. (Batteries and hot sauce sold separately.)
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  Love quotes for the ages. Specifically ages 18-81.

quotes.quote: Generally, by the time you are Real, most of your hair has been loved off, and your eyes drop out and you get loose in the joints and very shabby. But these things don't matter at all, because once you are Real you can't be ugly, except to people who don't understand.
quotes.author: Margery Williams,  The Velveteen Rabbit

quotes.quote: I suppose it's not a social norm, and not a manly thing to do -- to feel, discuss feelings. So that's what I'm giving the finger to. Social norms and stuff...what good are social norms, really? I think all they do is project a limited and harmful image of people. It thus impedes a broader social acceptance of what someone, or a group of people, might actually be like.
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  New Order

quotes.quote: Ahhh. Bed, book, kitten, sandwich. All one needed in life, really.
quotes.author: Jacqueline Kelly,  The Evolution of Calpurnia Tate

quotes.quote: An unread book does nobody any good. Stories happen in the mind of a reader, not among symbols printed on a page.
quotes.author: Brandon Mull

quotes.quote: Books, which we mistake for consolation, only add depth to our sorrow.
quotes.author: Orhan Pamuk,  My Name is Red

quotes.quote: An artist is someone who can hold two opposing viewpoints and still remain fully functional.
quotes.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

quotes.quote: The failure to read good books both enfeebles the vision and strengthens our most fatal tendency -- the belief that the here and now is all there is.
quotes.author: Allan Bloom,  The Closing of the American Mind

quotes.quote: I gave him my best cryptic smile. He did not fall down to his feet, kiss my shoes, and promise me the world. I must be getting rusty.
quotes.author: Ilona Andrews,  Magic Bites

quotes.quote: There was another reason [she] took her books whenever they went away. They were her home when she was somewhere strange. They were familiar voices, friends that never quarreled with her, clever, powerful friends -- daring and knowledgeable, tried and tested adventurers who had traveled far and wide. Her books cheered her up when she was sad and kept her from being bored.
quotes.author: Cornelia Funke,  Inkheart

quotes.quote: Life is too short to read books that I'm not enjoying.
quotes.author: Melissa Marr

quotes.quote: A successful book is not made of what is in it, but what is left out of it.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: Authors like cats because they are such quiet, lovable, wise creatures, and cats like authors for the same reasons.
quotes.author: Robertson Davies

quotes.quote: Early on I set out to write the next Great American Novel, and then later on I set out the silverware and enjoyed my dinner in silence.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

quotes.quote: You forget everything. The hours slip by. You travel in your chair through centuries you seem seem to see before you, your thoughts are caught up in the story, dallying with the details or following the course of the plot, you enter into characters, so that it seems as if it were your own heart beating beneath their costumes.
quotes.author: Gustave Flaubert,  Madame Bovary

quotes.quote: Reading gives us someplace to go when we have to stay where we are.
quotes.author: Mason Cooley

quotes.quote: There are perhaps no days of our childhood we lived so fully as those we believe we left without having lived them, those we spent with a favorite book.
quotes.author: Marcel Proust,  Days of Reading

quotes.quote: What better place to kill time than a library?
quotes.author: Diane Setterfield,  The Thirteenth Tale

quotes.quote: As long as you have any floor space at all, you have room for books! Just make two stacks of books the same height, place them three or four feet apart, lay a board across them, and repeat. Viola! Bookshelves!
quotes.author: Jan Karon

quotes.quote: The world is a hellish place, and bad writing is destroying the quality of our suffering.
quotes.author: Tom Waits

quotes.quote: Books may not change our suffering, books may not protect us from evil, books may not tell us what is good or what is beautiful, and they will certainly not shield us from the common fate of the grave. But books grant us myriad possibilities: the possibility of change, the possibility of illumination.
quotes.author: Alberto Manguel

quotes.quote: And this, our life, exempt from public haunt, finds tongues in trees, books in the running brooks, sermons in stones, and good in everything.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.quote: That's the whole point of good propaganda. You want to create a slogan that nobody's going to be against, and everybody's going to be for. Nobody knows what it means, because it doesn't mean anything.
quotes.author: Noam Chomsky

quotes.quote: One day I would have all the books in the world, shelves and shelves of them. I would live my life in a tower of books. I would read all day long and eat peaches. And if any young knights in armor dared to come calling on their white chargers and plead with me to let down my hair, I would pelt them with peach pits until they went home.
quotes.author: Jacqueline Kelly,  The Evolution of Calpurnia Tate

quotes.quote: People don't read any more. It's a sad state of affairs. Reading's the only thing that allows you to use your imagination. When you watch films it's someone else's vision, isn't it?"[Interview in The Independent, 15 October 2005]
quotes.author: Lemmy Kilmister

quotes.quote: I wish we could sometimes love the characters in real life as we love the characters in romances. There are a great many human souls whom we should accept more kindly, and even appreciate more clearly, if we simply thought of them as people in a story.
quotes.author: G.K. Chesterton,  What I Saw in America

quotes.quote: My hands could be considered deadly weapons. You see, I write with both of them.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Writing fiction is the act of weaving a series of lies to arrive at a greater truth.
quotes.author: Khaled Hosseini

quotes.quote: If your library is not "unsafe,"it probably isn't doing its job.
quotes.author: John Berry

quotes.quote: Libraries should be open to all - except the censor.[Response to questionnaire in Saturday Review, October 29 1960]
quotes.author: John F. Kennedy

quotes.quote: I know the X's and O's of football. I just don't know the other 24 letters. And as a writer, this bothers me.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: You see, unlike in the movies, there is no THE END sign flashing at the end of books. When I've read a book, I don't feel like I've finished anything. So I start a new one.
quotes.author: Elif Shafak,  The Bastard of Istanbul

quotes.quote: Reading is probably another way of being in a place.
quotes.author: JosÃ© Saramago,  El hombre duplicado

quotes.quote: A book is a device to ignite the imagination.
quotes.author: Alan Bennett,  The Uncommon Reader

quotes.quote: Some books leave us free and some books make us free.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: I owe everything I am and everything I will ever be to books.
quotes.author: Gary Paulsen,  Shelf Life: Stories by the Book

quotes.quote: I only read biographies, metaphysics and psychology. I can dream up my own fiction.
quotes.author: Mae West

quotes.quote: I'm old-fashioned and think that reading books is the most glorious pastime that humankind has yet devised.
quotes.author: WisÅ‚awa Szymborska,  Nonrequired Reading

quotes.quote: How many a man has dated a new era in his life from the reading of a book.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau,  Walden

quotes.quote: Rainy days should be spent at home with a cup of tea and a good book.
quotes.author: Bill Watterson,  The Calvin and Hobbes Tenth Anniversary Book

quotes.quote: When I discovered libraries, it was like having Christmas every day.
quotes.author: Jean Fritz

quotes.quote: Fill your house with stacks of books, in all the crannies and all the nooks.
quotes.author: Dr. Seuss

quotes.quote: Break the spine of one of my books and I break yours.
quotes.author: Mia James,  By Midnight

quotes.quote: those of us who read because we love it more than anything, who feel about bookstores the way some people feel about jewelers...
quotes.author: Anna Quindlen,  How Reading Changed My Life

quotes.quote: Come with me,' Mom says.To the library. Books and summertimego together.
quotes.author: Lisa Schroeder,  I Heart You, You Haunt Me

quotes.quote: In omnibus requiem quaesivi, et nusquam inveni nisi in angulo cum libro.(Everywhere I have sought peace and not found it, except in a corner with a book.)
quotes.author: Thomas Ã  Kempis

quotes.quote: I have lived a thousand lives and I've loved a thousand loves. I've walked on distant worlds and seen the end of time. Because I read.
quotes.author: George R.R. Martin

quotes.quote: Do not, under any circumstances, belittle a work of fiction by trying to turn it into a carbon copy of real life; what we search for in fiction is not so much reality but the epiphany of truth.
quotes.author: Azar Nafisi,  Reading Lolita in Tehran

quotes.quote: I fell in love with books. Some people find beauty in music, some in painting, some in landscape, but I find it in words. By beauty, I mean the feeling you have suddenly glimpsed another world, or looked into a portal that reveals a kind of magic or romance out of which the world has been constructed, a feeling there is something more than the mundane, and a reason for our plodding.
quotes.author: Donald Miller,  To Own a Dragon: Reflections on Growing Up Without a Father

quotes.quote: Often on a wet day I begin counting up; what I've read and what I haven't read.
quotes.author: Virginia Woolf,  Between the Acts

quotes.quote: When male authors write love stories, the heroine tends to end up dead.
quotes.author: Susan Elizabeth Phillips,  Ain't She Sweet

quotes.quote: It is clear that the books owned the shop rather than the other way about. Everywhere they had run wild and taken possession of their habitat, breeding and multiplying, and clearly lacking any strong hand to keep them down.
quotes.author: Agatha Christie,  The Clocks

quotes.quote: Books can not be killed by fire. People die, but books never die. No man and no force can abolish memory... In this war, we know, books are weapons. And it is a part of your dedication always to make them weapons for man's freedom.
quotes.author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

quotes.quote: Properly, we should read for power. Man reading should be man intensely alive. The book should be a ball of light in one's hand.
quotes.author: Ezra Pound

quotes.quote: In the library I felt better, words you could trust and look at till you understood them, they couldn't change half way through a sentence like people, so it was easier to spot a lie.
quotes.author: Jeanette Winterson,  Oranges Are Not the Only Fruit

quotes.quote: We're going to meet a lot of lonely people in the next week and the next month and the next year. And when they ask us what we're doing, you can say, We're remembering. That's where we'll win out in the long run. And someday we'll remember so much that we'll build the biggest goddamn steamshovel in history and dig the biggest grave of all time and shove war in it and cover it up.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury,  Fahrenheit 451

quotes.quote: I'm trying to undermine the basis of Christian belief... I'm not in the business of offending people. I find the books upholding certain values that I think are important, such as life is immensely valuable and this world is an extraordinarily beautiful place. We should do what we can to increase the amount of wisdom in the world.[Washington Post interview, 19 February 2001]
quotes.author: Philip Pullman

quotes.quote: Her reputation for reading a great deal hung about her like the cloudy envelope of a goddess in an epic.
quotes.author: Henry James,  The Portrait of a Lady

quotes.quote: Even a book can be dangerous in the wrong hands, and when that happens, you blame the hands, but you also read the book.
quotes.author: Erika Johansen,  The Queen of the Tearling

quotes.quote: A woman's destiny, they say, is not fulfilled until she holds in her arms her own little book.
quotes.author: Caroline Mytinger,  Headhunting In The Solomon Islands: Around The Coral Sea

quotes.quote: For books are more than books, they are the life, the very heart and core of ages past, the reason why men worked and died, the essence and quintessence of their lives.
quotes.author: Marcus Tullius Cicero

quotes.quote: Fiction is like a spider's web, attached ever so lightly perhaps, but still attached to life at all four corners.
quotes.author: Virginia Woolf,  A Room of One's Own

quotes.quote: Nobody steals books but your friends.
quotes.author: Roger Zelazny,  The Guns of Avalon

quotes.quote: Books... are like lobster shells, we surround ourselves with 'em, then we grow out of 'em and leave 'em behind, as evidence of our earlier stages of development.
quotes.author: Dorothy L. Sayers,  The Unpleasantness at the Bellona Club

quotes.quote: And books, they offer one hope -- that a whole universe might open up from between the covers, and falling into that universe, one is saved.
quotes.author: Anne Rice,  Blackwood Farm

quotes.quote: Thank you for sending me a copy of your book. I'll waste no time reading it.
quotes.author: Moses Hadas

quotes.quote: Just the knowledge that a good book is awaiting one at the end of a long day makes that day happier.
quotes.author: Kathleen Thompson Norris,  Hands Full of Living

quotes.quote: When I am king they shall not have bread and shelter only, but also teachings out of books, for a full belly is little worth where the mind is starved.
quotes.author: Mark Twain,  The Prince and the Pauper

quotes.quote: It is with books as with men: a very small number play a great part.
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.quote: A house without books is like a room without windows. No man has a right to bring up his children without surrounding them with books, if he has the means to buy them. It is a wrong to his family. He cheats them! Children learn to read by being in the presence of books. The love of knowledge comes with reading and grows upon it.
quotes.author: Horace Mann,  Life and Works of Horace Mann Volume 3

quotes.quote: Books are the bees which carry the quickening pollen from one to another mind.
quotes.author: James Russell Lowell

quotes.quote: She closed the book and put her cheek against it. There was still an odor of a library on it, of dust, leather, binding glue, and old paper, one book carrying the smell of hundreds.
quotes.author: Shannon Hale,  The Goose Girl

quotes.quote: Books - the best antidote against the marsh-gas of boredom and vacuity
quotes.author: George Steiner

quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.author: Anna Quindlen,  How Reading Changed My Life

quotes.quote: There never yet have been, nor are there now, too many good books.
quotes.author: Martin Luther

quotes.quote: There is something wonderful about a book. We can pick it up. We can heft it. We can read it. We can set it down. We can think of what we have read. It does something for us. We can share great minds, great actions, and great undertakings in the pages of a book.
quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley,  Standing for Something: Ten Neglected Virtues That Will Heal Our Hearts and Homes

quotes.quote: I can imagine no greater bliss than to lie about, reading novels all day.
quotes.author: Julia Quinn,  Ten Things I Love About You

quotes.quote: Books must be treated with respect, we feel that in our bones, because words have power. Bring enough words together they can bend space and time.
quotes.author: Terry Pratchett

quotes.quote: Books, the children of the brain.
quotes.author: Jonathan Swift,  A Tale Of A Tub And Other Writings

quotes.quote: If I could convert books to wine, I'd start with The Grapes of Wrath. I've never read it, but maybe tonight I'll be thirsty enough.

quotes.author: George Bernard Shaw

quotes.author: Jo Walton,  Among Others

quotes.quote: A good book is the precious life-blood of a master spirit, embalmed and treasured up on purpose to a life beyond life.

quotes.quote: Reading is not an end to itself, but a means to an end.
quotes.author: Adolf Hitler,  Mein Kampf

quotes.quote: A book is the only place in which you can examine a fragile thought without breaking it, or explore an explosive idea without fear it will go off in your face. It is one of the few havens remaining where a man's mind can get both provocation and privacy.
quotes.author: Edward P. Morgan

quotes.quote: You have to remember that it is impossible to commit a crime while reading a book.
quotes.author: John Waters

quotes.quote: A book lying idle on a shelf is wasted ammunition. Like money, books must be kept in constant circulation... A book is not only a friend, it makes friends for you. When you have possessed a book with mind and spirit, you are enriched. But when you pass it on you are enriched threefold.
quotes.author: Henry Miller,  The Books in My Life

quotes.quote: She breathed deeply of the scent of decaying fiction, disintegrating history, and forgotten verse, and she observed for the first time that a room full of books smelled like dessert: a sweet snack made of figs, vanilla, glue, and cleverness.
quotes.author: Joe Hill,  NOS4A2

quotes.quote: Some say life is the thing, but I prefer reading.
quotes.author: Ruth Rendell,  A Judgement in Stone

quotes.quote: I thought... that we could at least talk about books.

quotes.quote: The problem with books is that they end.

quotes.quote: Never put off till tomorrow the book you can read today.
quotes.author: Holbrook Jackson

quotes.quote: A stereotype becomes a stereotype when a significant percentage of the population appears to conform to it.
quotes.author: Kelley Armstrong,  Dime Store Magic

quotes.quote: Books are not about passing time. They're about other lives. Other worlds. Far from wanting time to pass, one just wishes one had more of it. If one wanted to pass the time one could go to New Zealand.

quotes.quote: I'm pretty sure my addiction to reading has just reached a whole new level.
quotes.author: Colleen Hoover,  Hopeless

quotes.quote: What an author doesn't know could fill a book.

quotes.author: Sven Birkerts,  The Gutenberg Elegies: The Fate of Reading in an Electronic Age

quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: A library outranks any other one thing a community can do to benefit its people. It is a never failing spring in the desert.
quotes.author: Andrew Carnegie

quotes.author: Colum McCann,  Let the Great World Spin

quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.author: J.R. Ward,  Lover Unbound

quotes.quote: When you re-read a classic you do not see in the book more than you did before. You see more in you than there was before.
quotes.author: Clifton Fadiman,  Any Number Can Play

quotes.author: Joseph Conrad

quotes.quote: When I'm really into a novel, I'm seeing the world differently during that time-- not just for the hour or so in the day when I get to read. I'm actually walking around in a haze, spellbound by the book and looking at everything through a different prism.
quotes.author: Colin Firth

quotes.quote: I think books are like people, in the sense that they'll turn up in your life when you most need them.

quotes.quote: I think of life as a good book. The further you get into it, the more it begins to make sense.
quotes.author: Harold S. Kushner

quotes.author: Betty Smith

quotes.quote: Books are to me as homemade tattoos are to an inmate. Can't get enough of them.

quotes.quote: It takes a certain ingenuous faith - but I have it - to believe that people who read and reflect more likely than not come to judge things with liberality and truth.

quotes.quote: I can promise you books and conversation and all my heart.

quotes.quote: Reading makes you ready for the world. A man who doesn't read is a man who is easily deceived. You must find that man and make him sign a contract, and you must do it before Satan does. Trust me, the profits are HUGE!

quotes.quote: I have never been able to resist a book about books.

quotes.quote: Books aren't written - they're rewritten. Including your own. It is one of the hardest things to accept, especially after the seventh rewrite hasn't quite done it.

quotes.quote: I don't know where people got the idea that characters in books are supposed to be likable. Books are not in the business of creating merely likeable characters with whom you can have some simple identification with. Books are in the business of creating great stories that make you're brain go ahhbdgbdmerhbergurhbudgerbudbaaarr.
quotes.author: John Green

quotes.quote: Just like heaven. Ever'body wants a little piece of lan'. I read plenty of books out here. Nobody never gets to heaven, and nobody gets no land. It's just in their head. They're all the time talkin' about it, but it's jus' in their head.
quotes.author: John Steinbeck,  Of Mice and Men

quotes.quote: It was like walking into a treasure trove of books, hoarded by pirate librarians.
quotes.author: Pseudonymous Bosch,  The Name of This Book Is Secret

quotes.quote: She turned to look at him, and he was already looking at her. 'I'm going to miss you when I wake up,' she whispered, because she realized that she must have fallen asleep under the sun. Arin was too real for her imagination. He was a dream.'Don't wake up,' he said.
quotes.author: Marie Rutkoski,  The Winner's Crime

quotes.quote: My bookcase is all yours."I walked to the door. "I've just decided that those are my favorite five words in the world.
quotes.author: Kasie West,  Pivot Point

quotes.quote: Get books, sit yourself down anywhere, and go to reading them yourself.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: I had found my religion: nothing seemed more important to me than a book. I saw the library as a temple.
quotes.author: Jean-Paul Sartre,  The Words

quotes.quote: Life is too short to waste time on books that end badly
quotes.author: Jayne Ann Krentz,  Running Hot

quotes.quote: If anything attacked us, we could just panic at it until it went away.
quotes.author: Seanan McGuire,  Rosemary and Rue

quotes.quote: No book worth its salt is meant to put you to sleep, it's meant to make you jump out of your bed in your underwear and run and beat the author's brains out.
quotes.author: Bohumil Hrabal

quotes.quote: His library was a fine dark place bricked with books, so anything could happen there and always did. All you had to do was pull a book from the shelf and open it and suddenly the darkness was not so dark anymore.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury,  Farewell Summer

quotes.quote: Writers are really people who write books not because they are poor, but because they are dissatisfied with the books which they could buy but do not like.
quotes.author: Walter Benjamin,  Illuminations: Essays and Reflections

quotes.quote: Books don't need batteries.
quotes.author: Nadine Gordimer

quotes.quote: I could recognise his soul in mine as much as he could find me in his. Our sole existences seemed to have been for this very moment when nothing else mattered.
quotes.author: X. Williamson,  Distract My Hunger

quotes.quote: But there is in everything a reasonable division of labour. I have written the book, and nothing on earth would induce me to read it.
quotes.author: G.K. Chesterton

quotes.quote: I think it is good that books still exist, but they do make me sleepy.
quotes.author: Frank Zappa

quotes.quote: Reading is going toward something that is about to be, and no one yet knows what it will be.
quotes.author: Italo Calvino,  If on a Winter's Night a Traveler

quotes.quote: Real life is physical. Give me books instead. Give me the invisibility of the contents of books, the thoughts, the ideas, the images. Let me become part of a book. . . . an intertextual being: a book cyborg, or, considering that books aren't cybernetic, perhaps a bibliorg.
quotes.author: Scarlett Thomas,  The End of Mr. Y

quotes.quote: I love inscriptions on flyleaves and notes in margins, I like the comradely sense of turning pages someone else turned, and reading passages someone long gone has called my attention to.
quotes.author: Helene Hanff,  84, Charing Cross Road

quotes.quote: Only the nonreader fears books.
quotes.author: Richard Peck

quotes.quote: Books and doors are the same thing. You open them, and you go through into another world.
quotes.author: Jeanette Winterson

quotes.quote: The world's greatest achievers have been those who have always stayed focussed on their goals and have been consistent in their efforts.
quotes.author: Roopleen,  Words to inspire the winner in YOU

quotes.quote: So here is my story, may it bringSome smiles and a tear or so,It happened once upon a time,Far away, and long ago,Outside the night wind keens and wails,Come listen to me, the Teller of Tales!
quotes.author: Brian Jacques,  Lord Brocktree

quotes.quote: Books can ignite fires in your mind, because they carry ideas for kindling, and art for matches.
quotes.author: Gary D. Schmidt,  Lizzie Bright and the Buckminster Boy

quotes.quote: Books are the most wonderful friends in the world. When you meet them and pick them up, they are always ready to give you a few ideas. When you put them down, they never get mad; when you take them up again, they seem to enrich you all the more.
quotes.author: Fulton J. Sheen,  Life Is Worth Living

quotes.quote: Bloodthirsty little beasts. Never trust a duck.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  Clockwork Angel

quotes.quote: Read. Read anything. Read the things they say are good for you, and the things they claim are junk. You'll find what you need to find. Just read.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman

quotes.quote: If I told you that my global audience has shot up 100% in the last six months, what would you say? If you were to say, 'So you went from one reader to two readers?' you'd be absolutely correct. And after I had congratulated you on your keen guess, I'd thank you for being 50% of my reading base.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: In my fool hardy youth, when my friends were dreaming of heroic deeds in the realms of engineering and law, finance and national politics, I dreamt of becoming a librarian.
quotes.author: Alberto Manguel,  The Library at Night

quotes.quote: We can imagine the books we'd like to read, even if they have not yet been written, and we can imagine libraries full of books we would like to possess, even if they are well beyond our reach, because we enjoy dreaming up a library that reflects every one of our interests and every one of our foibles--a library that, in its variety and complexity, fully reflects the reader we are.
quotes.author: Alberto Manguel

quotes.quote: To feel most beautifully alive means to be reading something beautiful, ready always to apprehend in the flow of language the sudden flash of poetry.
quotes.author: Gaston Bachelard

quotes.quote: All that mankind has done, thought, gained, or been; it is lying as in magic preservation in the pages of books.
quotes.author: Thomas Carlyle

quotes.quote: Professors of literature collect books the way a ship collects barnacles, without seeming effort.
quotes.author: Carolyn G. Heilbrun,  Death in a Tenured Position

quotes.quote: I still remember the day my father took me to the Cemetery of Forgotten Books for the first time.
quotes.author: Carlos Ruiz ZafÃ³n,  The Shadow of the Wind

quotes.quote: It's too late to apologize for I have already forgiven you."-FitzChivalry Farseer
quotes.author: Robin Hobb

quotes.quote: Reading is my favourite occupation, when I have leisure for it and books to read.
quotes.author: Anne BrontÃ«,  Agnes Grey

quotes.quote: Right now, we're living in an ugly chapter of our lives, but books always get better!
quotes.author: Chris Colfer,  The Wishing Spell

quotes.quote: To live is to have worries and uncertainties. Keep them inside, and they will destroy you for certain--leaving behind a person so callused that emotion can find no root in his heart.
quotes.author: Brandon Sanderson,  Elantris

quotes.quote: I've developed a great reputation for wisdom by ordering more books than I ever had time to read, and reading more books, by far, than I learned anything useful from, except, of course, that some very tedious gentlemen have written books.
quotes.author: Marilynne Robinson,  Gilead

quotes.quote: Reading is reading - no matter what the material.
quotes.author: Giovanna Fletcher,  Billy and Me

quotes.quote: Prometheus, thief of light, giver of light, bound by the gods, must have been a book.
quotes.author: Mark Z. Danielewski,  House of Leaves

quotes.quote: Books have a way of finding their way into our lives, usually, right when we need them the most.
quotes.author: Richard P. Denney

quotes.quote: No one knows as well as I how much nonsense is printed in books.
quotes.author: Julia Quinn,  Romancing Mister Bridgerton

quotes.quote: Some like to believe it's the book that chooses the person.
quotes.author: Carlos Ruiz ZafÃ³n

quotes.quote: Reading made Don Quixote a gentleman. Believing what he read made him mad.
quotes.author: George Bernard Shaw

quotes.quote: There are books so alive that you're always afraid that while you weren't reading, the book has gone and changed, has shifted like a river; while you went on living, it went on living too, and like a river moved on and moved away. No one has stepped twice into the same river. But did anyone ever step twice into the same book?
quotes.author: Marina Tsvetaeva

quotes.quote: I only want power so I can get books.
quotes.author: Eliezer Yudkowsky,  Harry Potter and the Methods of Rationality

quotes.quote: Books didn't make me wallow in darkness, darkness made me wallow in books.
quotes.author: Jackson Pearce

quotes.quote: ....a good book can teach you about the world and about yourself. You learn more than how to read better; you also learn more about life. You become wiser. Not just more knowledgeable - books that provide nothing but information can produce that result. But wiser, in the sense that you are more deeply aware of the great and enduring truths of human life.
quotes.author: Mortimer J. Adler,  How to Read a Book: The Classic Guide to Intelligent Reading

quotes.quote: Allowing yourself to stop reading a book - at page 25, 50, or even, less frequently, a few chapters from the end - is a rite of passage in a reader's life, the literary equivalent of a bar mitzvah or a communion, the moment at which you look at yourself and announce: Today I am an adult. I can make my own decisions.
quotes.author: Sara Nelson,  So Many Books, So Little Time: A Year of Passionate Reading

quotes.quote: Lovers of print are simply confusing the plate for the food.
quotes.author: Douglas Adams

quotes.quote: Nothing was truly unbearable if you had something to read.
quotes.author: Jincy Willett,  The Writing Class

quotes.quote: I hate to lend a book I love...it never seems quite the same when it comes back to me...
quotes.author: L.M. Montgomery,  Anne of Windy Poplars

quotes.quote: Read not to contradict and confute, nor to believe and take for granted ...but to weigh and consider.
quotes.author: Francis Bacon

quotes.quote: The true birthplace is that wherein for the first time one looks intelligently upon oneself; my first homelands have been books, and to a lesser degree schools.
quotes.author: Marguerite Yourcenar,  Memoirs of Hadrian

quotes.quote: Tis the good reader that makes the good book.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: There are essentially two things that will make you wise -- the books you read and the people you meet.
quotes.author: Jack Canfield

quotes.quote: If books are not good company, where shall I find it?
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: He ate and drank the precious words,His spirit grew robust;He knew no more that he was poor,Nor that his frame was dust.He danced along the dingy days,And this bequest of wingsWas but a book. What libertyA loosened spirit brings!
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson

quotes.quote: ...writers are a savage breed, Mr. Strike. If you want life-long friendship and selfless camaraderie, join the army and learn to kill. If you want a lifetime of temporary alliances with peers who will glory in your every failure, write novels.
quotes.author: Robert Galbraith,  The Silkworm

quotes.quote: Because when I read, I don't really read; I pop a beautiful sentence into my mouth and suck it like a fruit drop, or I sip it like a liqueur until the thought dissolves in me like alcohol, infusing brain and heart and coursing on through the veins to the root of each blood vessel.
quotes.author: Bohumil Hrabal,  Too Loud a Solitude

quotes.quote: Good books are about everything.
quotes.author: Andrew Smith,  Grasshopper Jungle

quotes.quote: Have you thought of an ending?""Yes, several, and all are dark and unpleasant.""Oh, that won't do! Books ought to have good endings. How would this do: and they all settled down and lived together happily ever after?""It will do well, if it ever came to that.""Ah! And where will they live? That's what I often wonder.
quotes.author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Fellowship of the Ring

quotes.quote: The books we read should be chosen with great care, that they may be, as an Egyptian king wrote over his library,'The medicines of the soul.
quotes.author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.

quotes.quote: Censorship is the child of fear and the father of ignorance.
quotes.author: Laurie Halse Anderson,  Speak

quotes.quote: Worst of all, the inner vault is guarded by a live dragon, attended by fifty naked women armed with poisoned spears, each of them sworn to die in Requin's service. All redheads.-You're just making that up, Jean.
quotes.author: Scott Lynch,  Red Seas Under Red Skies

quotes.quote: Associate with noblest people you can find; read the best books; live with the mighty. But learn to be happy alone.  Rely upon your own energies, and so not wait for, or depend on other people.
quotes.author: Thomas Davidson

quotes.quote: I find Bukowski to be so edgy, gritty, and daring that he oozes romance, and if couples read him in bed they would appreciate what they have.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Beware you be not swallowed up in books! An ounce of love is worth a pound of knowledge.
quotes.author: John Wesley,  Letters of John Wesley

quotes.quote: What I saw next stopped me dead in my tracks. Books. Not just one or two dozen, but hundreds of them. In crates. In piles on the floor. In bookcases that stretched from floor to ceiling and lined the entire room. I turned around and around in a slow circle, feeling as if I'd just stumbled into Ali Baba's cave. I was breathless, close to tears, and positively dizzy with greed.
quotes.author: Jennifer Donnelly,  A Northern Light

quotes.quote: I had found a new friend. The surprising thing is where I'd found him - not up a tree or sulking in the shade, or splashing around in one of the hill streams, but in a book. No one had told us kids to look there for a friend. Or that you could slip inside the skin of another. Or travel to another place with marshes, and where, to our ears, the bad people spoke like pirates.
quotes.author: Lloyd Jones,  Mister Pip

quotes.quote: All of us can think of a book... that we hope none of our children or any other children have taken off the shelf. But if I have the right to remove that book from the shelf - that work I abhor - then you also have exactly the same right and so does everyone else. And then we have no books left on the shelf for any of us.
quotes.author: Katherine Paterson

quotes.quote: Booksellers are the most valuable destination for the lonely, given the numbers of books written because authors couldn't find anyone to talk to.
quotes.author: Alain de Botton,  The Consolations of Philosophy

quotes.quote: Books are like truth serum-- if you don't read, you can't figure out what's real.
quotes.author: Rodman Philbrick,  Freak the Mighty

quotes.quote: ...Something we once loved, and love now, in the shape of a book. Maybe eBooks are going to take over, one day, but not until those whizzkids in Silicon Valley invent a way to bend the corners, fold the spine, yellow the pages, add a coffee ring or two and allow the plastic tablet to fall open at a favorite page.
quotes.author: Russell T. Davies,  The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

quotes.quote: We become the books we read.
quotes.author: Matthew Kelly

quotes.quote: Apa gunanya banyak baca bukuKalau mulut kau bungkam melulu

quotes.quote: To prohibit the reading of certain books is to declare the inhabitants to be either fools or slaves.
quotes.author: Claude Adrien HelvÃ©tius

quotes.quote: Reading is my passion and my escape since I was 5 years old. Overall, children don't realize the magic that can live inside their own heads. Better even then any movie.
quotes.author: Eckhart Tolle,  The Power of Now: A Guide to Spiritual Enlightenment

quotes.quote: Dreams, books, are each a world; and books, we know,Are a substantial world, both pure and good:Round these, with tendrils strong as flesh and blood,Our pastime and our happiness will grow.
quotes.author: William Wordsworth

quotes.quote: What amazes me is that most days feel useless. I don't seem to accomplish anything-just a few pages, most of which don't seem very good. Yet, when I put all those wasted days together, I somehow end up with a book of which I'm very proud.
quotes.author: Louis Sachar

quotes.quote: It looked like the sort of book described in library catalogues as 'slightly foxed', although it would be more honest to admit that it looked as though it had been badgered, wolved and possibly beared as well.
quotes.author: Terry Pratchett,  The Light Fantastic

quotes.quote: What is wonderful about great literature is that it transforms the man who reads it towards the condition of the man who wrote.
quotes.author: E.M. Forster,  Two Cheers for Democracy

quotes.quote: I'd volunteer to go to prison, as long as there are books. Because with books I am free.
quotes.author: Mohammad Hatta

quotes.quote: Sometimes I think books are the only friends worth having.
quotes.author: Susie Derkins

quotes.quote: I can think of few better ways to introduce a child to books than to let her stack them, upend them, rearrange them, and get her fingerprints all over them.
quotes.author: Anne Fadiman,  Ex Libris: Confessions of a Common Reader

quotes.quote: The good, the admirable reader identifies himself not with the boy or the girl in the book, but with the mind that conceived and composed that book.
quotes.author: Vladimir Nabokov

quotes.quote: An hour spent reading is one stolen from paradise.
quotes.author: Thomas Wharton

quotes.quote: I care more about the people in books than the people I see every day.
quotes.author: Jo Walton,  Among Others

quotes.quote: Censorship of anything, at any time, in any place, on whatever pretense, has always been and always will be the last resort of the boob and the bigot.
quotes.author: Eugene O'Neill

quotes.quote: I have gone to [this bookshop] for years, always finding the one book I wanted - and then three more I hadn't known I wanted.
quotes.author: Mary Ann Shaffer,  The Guernsey Literary and Potato Peel Pie Society

quotes.quote: When we are collecting books, we are collecting happiness.
quotes.author: Vincent Starrett

quotes.quote: When I was a child, books were everything. And so there is in me, always, a nostalgic, yearning for the lost pleasure of books. It is not a yearning that one ever expects to be fulfilled.
quotes.author: Diane Setterfield,  The Thirteenth Tale

quotes.quote: I think that every reader on earth has a list of cherished books as unique as their fingerprints....I think that, as you age, you tend to gravitate towards the classics, but those aren't the books that give you the same sort of hope for the world that a cherished book does.
quotes.author: Douglas Coupland

quotes.quote: Standing there, staring at the long shelves crammed with books, I felt myself relax and was suddenly at peace.
quotes.author: Helene Hanff,  Q's Legacy

quotes.quote: We lusty bibliophiles know that reading, unlike just about anything else, is both good for you and loads of fun.
quotes.author: Kevin Smokler,  Bookmark Now: Writing in Unreaderly Times: A Collection of All Original Essays from Today's (and Tomorrow's) Young Authors on the State of the Art --and the Art of the Hustle--in the Age of Information Overload

quotes.quote: The books are to remind us what asses and fools we are.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury,  Fahrenheit 451

quotes.quote: It has long been my belief that everyone's library contains an Odd Shelf. On this shelf rests a small, mysterious corpus of volumes whose subject matter is completely unrelated to the rest of the library, yet which, upon closer inspection, reveals a good deal about its owner.
quotes.author: Anne Fadiman,  Ex Libris: Confessions of a Common Reader

quotes.quote: Books let us into their souls and lay open to us the secrets of our own."[The Sick Chamber (The New Monthly Magazine , August 1830)]
quotes.author: William Hazlitt,  Essays of William Hazlitt: Selected and Edited, with Introduction and Notes, by Frank Carr

quotes.quote: She did not care very much for other little girls, but if she had plenty of books she could console herself.
quotes.author: Frances Hodgson Burnett,  A Little Princess

quotes.quote: Books wrote our life story, and as they accumulated on our shelves (and on our windowsills, and underneath our sofa, and on top of our refrigerator), they became chapters in it themselves.
quotes.author: Anne Fadiman,  Ex Libris: Confessions of a Common Reader

quotes.quote: These are all novels, all about people that never existed, the people that read them it makes them unhappy with their own lives. Makes them want to live in other ways they can never really be.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury,  Fahrenheit 451

quotes.quote: Censoring books that deal with difficult, adolescent issues does not protect anybody. Quite the opposite. It leaves kids in the darkness and makes them vulnerable. Censorship is the child of fear and the father of ignorance. Our children cannot afford to have the truth of the world withheld from them
quotes.author: Laurie Halse Anderson

quotes.quote: A novel is not an allegory.... It is the sensual experience of another world. If you don't enter that world, hold your breath with the characters and become involved in their destiny, you won't be able to empathize, and empathy is at the heart of the novel. This is how you read a novel: you inhale the experience. So start breathing.
quotes.author: Azar Nafisi

quotes.quote: How much sooner one tires of anything than of a book!
quotes.author: Jane Austen,  Pride and Prejudice

quotes.quote: Men have had every advantage of us in telling their own story. Education has been theirs in so much higher a degree; the pen has been in their hands. I will not allow books to prove anything.
quotes.author: Jane Austen,  Persuasion

quotes.quote: it is nice that nobody writes as they talk and that the printed language is different from the spoken otherwise you could not lose yourself in books and of course you do you completely do.
quotes.author: Gertrude Stein

quotes.quote: Well, I don't like the first bit and I don't know the last bit. So I'm really hoping the middle bit is exceptional.
quotes.author: Eoin Colfer

quotes.quote: The feel of them (books) and the smell of them. A bookshop was like an Aladdin's cave for me. Entire worlds and lives can be found just behind that glossy cover. All you had to do was look."Claire (Watermelon)
quotes.author: Marian Keyes,  Watermelon

quotes.quote: If a book is well written, I always find it too short.
quotes.author: Jane Austen,  Sense and Sensibility

quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  The Darker Side of Life

quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  EyeLeash: A Blog Novel

quotes.quote: Every reader exists to ensure for a certain book a modest immortality. Reading is, in this sense, a ritual of rebirth.
quotes.author: Alberto Manguel,  The Library at Night

quotes.quote: The best of a book is not the thought which it contains, but the thought which it suggests; just as the charm of music dwells not in the tones but in the echoes of our hearts.
quotes.author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.

quotes.quote: I don't remember ever feeling lonely; in fact, on the rare occasions when I met other children I found their games and their talk far less interesting than the adventures and dialogues I read in my books.
quotes.author: Alberto Manguel,  A History of Reading

quotes.quote: I wrote a book. It sucked. I wrote nine more books. They sucked, too. Meanwhile, I read every single thing I could find on publishing and writing, went to conferences, joined professional organizations, hooked up with fellow writers in critique groups, and didn't give up. Then I wrote one more book.
quotes.author: Beth Revis

quotes.quote: I wanted a library like this...[] A cave of words that I'd made myself.
quotes.author: Maggie Stiefvater,  Forever

quotes.quote: Overall, the library held a hushed exultation, as though the cherished volumes were all singing soundlessly within their covers.
quotes.author: Diana Gabaldon,  Outlander

quotes.author: Kiersten White

quotes.quote: I regained my soul through literature after those times I'd lost it to wild-eyed gypsy girls on the European streets.
quotes.author: Roman Payne,  Rooftop Soliloquy

quotes.quote: I have all the books I could need, and what more could I need than books?
quotes.author: Catherynne M. Valente,  The Girl Who Ruled Fairyland - For a Little While

quotes.quote: These are not books, lumps of lifeless paper, but minds alive on the shelves. quotes.quote: Some books are so familiar that reading them is like being home again.

quotes.quote: As you grow ready for it, somewhere or other you will find what is needful for you in a book.

quotes.quote: My books are friends that never fail me."(Letter to his mother, Margaret A. Carlyle; 17 March 1817)
quotes.author: Thomas Carlyle

quotes.quote: Learning became her. She loved the smell of the book from the shelves, the type on the pages, the sense that the world was an infinite but knowable place. Every fact she learned seemed to open another question, and for every question there was another book.

quotes.quote: A capacity, and taste, for reading, gives access to whatever has already been discovered by others. It is the key, or one of the keys, to the already solved problems. And not only so. It gives a relish, and facility, for successfully pursuing the [yet] unsolved ones.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: What I will be remembered for are the Foundation Trilogy and the Three Laws of Robotics. What I want to be remembered for is no one book, or no dozen books. Any single thing I have written can be paralleled or even surpassed by something someone else has done. However, my total corpus for quantity, quality and variety can be duplicated by no one else. That is what I want to be remembered for.
quotes.author: Isaac Asimov

quotes.quote: Only five books tonight, Mommy,"she says.No, Olivia, just one."How about four?"Two."Three."Oh, all right, three. But that's it!
quotes.author: Ian Falconer,  Olivia

quotes.quote: Anything can become a children's book if you give it to a child...Children are actually the best (and worst) audience for literature because they have no patience with pretence.
quotes.author: Orson Scott Card

quotes.quote: My books hold between their covers every story I've ever known and still remember, or have now forgotten, or may one day read; they fill the space around me with ancient and new voices.
quotes.author: Alberto Manguel,  The Library at Night

quotes.quote: Everyone creates realities based on their own personal beliefs. These beliefs are so powerful that they can create [expansive or entrapping] realities over and over.~Kuan Yin
quotes.author: Hope Bradford,  Beneficial Law of Attraction: The Manifestation Teachings

quotes.quote: Opportunity may knock only once but temptation leans on the door bell
quotes.author: Oprah Winfrey,  Oprah Winfrey Speaks: Insights from the World's Most Influential Voice

quotes.quote: She'd felt it before, she felt it now: the pull to fall in with him, to fall into him, to lose her sense of self.
quotes.author: Marie Rutkoski,  The Winner's Crime

quotes.quote: An emotion clamped down on her heart. It squeezed her into a terrible silence. But he said nothing after that, only her name, as if her name were not a name but a question. Or perhaps that it wasn't how he had said it, and she was wrong, and she'd heard a question simply because the sound of him speaking her name made her wish that she were his answer.
quotes.author: Marie Rutkoski,  The Winner's Crime

quotes.quote: The best book is not one that informs merely, but one that stirs the reader up to inform himself.
quotes.author: A.W. Tozer,  Man The Dwelling Place Of God

quotes.quote: The flesh is sad, alas, and I have read all the books.
quotes.author: StÃ©phane MallarmÃ©

quotes.quote: One of my heroes, G.K. Chesterton, said, "The old fairy tales endure forever. The old fairy tale makes the hero a normal human boy; it is his adventures that are startling; they startle him because he is normal."Discovering that the modern world can still contain the wonder and strangeness of a fairy tale is part of what my novels are about.
quotes.author: Regina Doman

quotes.quote: Tis the good reader that makes the good book; in every book he finds passages which seem confidences or asides hidden from all else and unmistakenly meant for his ear; the profit of books is according to the sensibility of the reader; the profoundest thought or passion sleeps as in a mine, until it is discovered by an equal mind and heart.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: To all my librarian friends, champions of books, true magicians in the House of Life. Without you, this writer would be lost in the Dust.
quotes.author: Rick Riordan,  The Red Pyramid

quotes.quote: In a few minutes I heard the books' voices: a low, steady, unsupressible hum. I'd heard it many times before. I've always had a finely tuned ear for a library's accumulations of echo and desire. Libraries are anything but hushed.
quotes.author: Martha Cooley,  The Archivist

quotes.quote: There were two sets of double doors leading out of the antechamber, one marked STACKS and the other TOMES. Not knowing the difference between the two, I headed to the ones labeled STACKS. That was what I wanted. Stacks of books. Great heaps of books. Shelf after endless shelf of books.
quotes.author: Patrick Rothfuss,  The Name of the Wind

quotes.quote: My last refuge, my books: simple pleasures, like finding wild onions by the side of a road, or requited love.
quotes.author: Tracy Letts,  August: Osage County

quotes.quote: A book is a wonderful present. Though it may grow worn, it will never grow old.
quotes.author: Jane Yolen,  Girl in a Cage

quotes.quote: A good book will pull you in from the beginning and take you on a journey you'll never forget.
quotes.author: Lauren Hammond

quotes.quote: I remember the hours I had spent in Father's library, drugging myself with books so I could forget my doom for an hour..
quotes.author: Rosamund Hodge,  Cruel Beauty

quotes.quote: Woe be to him that reads but one book.
quotes.author: George Herbert

quotes.quote: Now begin in the middle, and later learn the beginning; the end will take care of itself.
quotes.author: Harlan Ellison

quotes.quote: Lolita is famous, not I. I am an obscure, doubly obscure, novelist with an unpronounceable name.
quotes.author: Vladimir Nabokov

quotes.quote: Knowing I lov'd my books, he furnish'd me From mine own library with volumes that I prize above my dukedom.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.quote: A book read by a thousand different people is a thousand different books.
quotes.author: Andrei Tarkovsky

quotes.quote: Even if you are alone you wage war with yourself.
quotes.author: Dejan Stojanovic,  The Sun Watches the Sun

quotes.quote: It is time to float on the waters of the night. Time to wrap my arms around this book and press it to my chest, life preserver in a sea of unremarkable men and women, anonymous faces on the street, a hundred thousand unalphabetized things, a million forgotten hours.
quotes.author: Billy Collins,  Picnic, Lightning

quotes.quote: Tell me I didn't imagine it, Leo. Tell me that even though our bodies were in seperate states, our star selves shared an enchanted place. Tell me that right around noon today (eastern time) you had the strangest sensation: a tiny chill on your shoulder...a flutter in the heart...a shadow of strawberry-banana crossing your tongue...tell me you whispered my name.
quotes.author: Jerry Spinelli

quotes.quote: Books are the compasses and telescopes and sextants and charts which other men have prepared to help us navigate the dangerous seas of human life.
quotes.author: Jesse Lee Bennett

quotes.quote: Did you ever hear anyone say, 'That work had better be banned because I might read it and it might be very damaging to me'?
quotes.author: Joseph Henry Jackson

quotes.quote: Every face, every shop, bedroom window, public-house, and dark square is a picture feverishly turned--in search of what? It is the same with books. What do we seek through millions of pages?
quotes.author: Virginia Woolf,  Jacob's Room

quotes.quote: This must be what an addict feels like, I think, trying to fight the pull of one last, quick read. My fingers itch toward the binding, and finally, with a sigh of regret, I just grab the book and open it, hungrily reading the story.
quotes.author: Jodi Picoult,  Between the Lines

quotes.quote: The thing about Tolkien, about The Lord of the Rings, is that it's perfect. It's this whole world, this whole process of immersion, this journey. It's not, I'm pretty sure, actually true, but that makes it more amazing, that someone could make it all up. Reading it changes everything.
quotes.author: Jo Walton,  Among Others

quotes.quote: And what would happen if we never read the classics? There comes a point in life, it seems to me, where you have to decide whether you're a Person of Letters or merely someone who loves books, and I'm beginning to see that the book lovers have more fun.
quotes.author: Nick Hornby,  Housekeeping vs. the Dirt

quotes.quote: As a fan of Agatha Christie, I think a brilliant mystery novel would be trying to identify the meat contents in a McDonald's hamburger.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  Xazaqazax

quotes.author: Kate Morton,  The Distant Hours

quotes.quote: I truly believe that if you have more friends than books, you have too many friends. Or not enough books. Probably both.
quotes.author: ZoÃ« Marriott

quotes.quote: The real purpose of books is to trap the mind into doing its own thinking.
quotes.author: Christopher Morley

quotes.quote: The dirtiest book of all is the expurgated book.
quotes.author: Walt Whitman

quotes.quote: anyone who's worth anything reads just what he likes, as the mood takes him, and with extravagant enthusiasm.
quotes.author: Virginia Woolf,  Jacob's Room

quotes.quote: You can cover a great deal of country in books.
quotes.author: Andrew Lang

quotes.quote: I have no feelings of guilt regarding the books I have not read and perhaps will never read; I know that my books have unlimited patience. They will wait for me till the end of my days.
quotes.author: Alberto Manguel,  The Library at Night

quotes.quote: I read in self-defense.
quotes.author: Woody Allen

quotes.quote: When I want to read a novel, I write one.
quotes.author: Benjamin Disraeli

quotes.quote: A good book is the precious life-blood of a master-spirit, embalmed and treasured up on purpose to a life beyond life, and as such it must surely be a necessary commodity.
quotes.author: Penelope Fitzgerald,  The Bookshop

quotes.quote: Not that she objected to solitude. Quite the contrary. She had books, thank Heaven, quantities of books. All sorts of books.
quotes.author: Jean Rhys,  Quartet

quotes.quote: When you read to a child, when you put a book in a child's hands, you are bringing that child news of the infinitely varied nature of life. You are an awakener.
quotes.author: Paula Fox

quotes.quote: Write it down, boy. If you come across a passage in your reading that you'd like to remember, write it down in your little book; then you can read it again, memorize it, and have it whenever you wish.
quotes.author: Keith Donohue

quotes.quote: Books swept me away, this way and that, one after the other; I made endless vows according to their lights for I believed them.
quotes.author: Annie Dillard

quotes.quote: A book is an arrangement of twenty-six phonetic symbols, ten numerals, and about eight punctuation marks, and people can cast their eyes over these and envision the eruption of Mount Vesuvius or the Battle of Waterloo.
quotes.author: Kurt Vonnegut

quotes.quote: The ability to retain a child's view of the world with at the same time a mature understanding of what it means to retain it, is extremely rare - and a person who has these qualities is likely to be able to contribute something really important to our thinking.
quotes.author: Mortimer J. Adler,  How to Read a Book: The Classic Guide to Intelligent Reading

quotes.quote: All novels are sequels; influence is bliss.
quotes.author: Michael Chabon

quotes.quote: And what would they be scared of? There's nothing to fear in a perfect world, is there?
quotes.author: Catherine Fisher

quotes.author: Betty Smith,  A Tree Grows in Brooklyn

quotes.quote: A censor is an expert in cutting remarks. A censor is a man who knows more than he thinks you ought to.
quotes.author: Laurence J. Peter

quotes.quote: For every book you buy, you should buy the time to read it.
quotes.author: Karl Lagerfeld

It is far, far better to read one book six times, at intervals, than to read six several books.
quotes.author: D.H. Lawrence,  Apocalypse

quotes.quote: Mother used to say escape is never further than the nearest book.
quotes.author: David Mitchell,  Cloud Atlas

quotes.quote: Who was it who said, "I hold the buying of more books than one can peradventure read, as nothing less than the soul's reaching towards infinity; which is the only thing that raises us above the beasts that perish?"Whoever it was, I agree with him.
quotes.author: A. Edward Newton,  A Magnificent Farce And Other Diversions Of A Book Collector

quotes.quote: A big book is like a serious relationship; it requires a commitment. Not only that, but there's no guarantee that you will enjoy it, or that it will have a happy ending. quotes.author: Mick Foley

quotes.quote: It is time to browse through the precious books that have meant the most to you that you may rediscover illuminating phrases and sentences to light your pathway to the future...
quotes.author: Wilferd Peterson

quotes.quote: There was something appealing in thinking of a character with a secret life that her author knew nothing about. Slipping off while the author's back was turned, to find love in her own way. Showing up just in time to deliver the next bit of dialogue with an innocent face.
quotes.author: Karen Joy Fowler

quotes.quote: Cakes are like books: There are new ones you want to read and old favorites you want to reread.
quotes.author: Ellen Rose

quotes.quote: Remind me not to piss you off Red. You might aim for the heart and shoot me in the balls.
quotes.author: Nora Roberts,  Morrigan's Cross

quotes.author: Russell Brand,  My Booky Wook

quotes.quote: Writing a long and substantial book is like having a friend and companion at your side, to whom you can always turn for comfort and amusement, and whose society becomes more attractive as a new and widening field of interest is lighted in the mind.
quotes.author: Winston S. Churchill

quotes.quote: One wants to tell a story, like Scheherezade, in order not to die. It's one of the oldest urges in mankind. It's a way of stalling death.

quotes.author: Thorne Smith

quotes.author: Stefan Zweig,  The Post-Office Girl

quotes.quote: There is only one genre in fiction, the genre is called book.
quotes.author: Matt Haig,  The Humans

quotes.quote: With no reason to hide these words I feel, and no reason to talk about the books I read, but still, I do.
quotes.author: Morrissey

quotes.author: Tom Wolfe

quotes.author: Robert Clark

quotes.quote: Maybe the books can get us half out of the cave. They just might stop us from making the same damm insane mistakes!
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury,  Fahrenheit 451

quotes.quote: I love to lose myself in other men's minds.... Books think for me.
quotes.author: Charles Lamb

quotes.quote: I am a part of all I have read.
quotes.author: John Kieran

quotes.quote: And of course I'm in the press all the time. So many books have been written about me; Into thin air, up in the air,Gone with the wind-
quotes.author: Rick Riordan,  The Lost Hero
